 📸 This picture says it all! Ronaldo misses yet another penalty 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Cristiano Ronaldo is edging closer to the 1,000-goal milestone. However, he also suffered a setback along the way. 
 His club Al-Nassr are currently playing Al-Ahli, and CR7 had reason to celebrate. He scored the 986th goal of his career, leaving him just 14 short. 
 OneFootball Videos
 That gap could have been even smaller, but the Portuguese superstar missed a penalty shortly afterwards. It was his second consecutive penalty miss. He also failed to convert from the spot in the 1-0 win over Neom in mid-October. This photo shows just how frustrated he was today after his effort hit the post. 
 📸 - CRISTIANO RONALDO COULDN’T BELIEVE HE MISSED THAT PENALTY!
HE CAN’T STOP SCREAMING!  –  Friday, 20 November 2026 
 Sometimes a picture really is worth a thousand words.
 How many more games will CR7 need to reach 1,000 goals? Let us know what you think in the comments. 
 This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence. You can read the original version in 🇩🇪 here.
